rounds.text: [Nikita Greentech Recycling Ltd (NIKITA) trades at a P/E of 16.3 [E1], which is significantly higher than its sector benchmark of 14.82x [E6]. [Nikita Greentech Recycling Ltd (NIKITA) has a Median Return on Equity over 5 years of 17% [E21], and over 3 years of 17% [E22]. The fact that NIKITA's Median Return on Equity over last year is only 8% [E23] further implies that investors are overlooking this historical performance and potential future growth. [Nikita Greentech Recycling Ltd (NIKITA) has a Discounted Cash Flow model indicating an intrinsic value of Rs 182 per share against the market price of Rs 73.4 [E39]. While there are some areas of concern such as a low P/E ratio and a relatively narrow stock price range within its 52-week range, these do not outweigh the evidence pointing towards NIKITA's potential for value creation and growth. Nikita Greentech Recycling Ltd (NIKITA) offers significant upside potential, warranting further investigation by investors."
